rollback.note: 2.0.3 shows coordinates as [row,col], lets words break across decoder lines and has no Chinese mode; saved settings that choose Chinese fall back to the defaults there.

changes: Decoder fields read [column,row] (first number across, second down); screen readers say the column first and the tutorial explains the new order. The chart and the coordinate data are unchanged, and logic/hartChart.ts keeps its pinned SHA-256

Each decoder word is one group that never breaks across lines, with a 14px space between words (10px on phones). Cells narrow to fit the longest word down to 28px, and a left or right dock widens, up to 55% of the workspace, when that minimum still does not fit
New setting 解碼文字 (characterSet): english (default) or chinese, independent of the interface language and saved in the result config

Chinese mode: 13 Traditional Chinese everyday phrases grouped by word, a seeded 100-cell chart (two copies of each phrase character, 78 common filler characters, no identical neighbours in a row), lang=zh-Hant glyphs and a 0.82 chart font factor; the QR screen URL carries characters=chinese
Chinese answers are typed with an input method and judged after composition ends; phonetic symbols while composing, Safari's repeated input event and a cancelled composition do not count as attempts
The tutorial's 「重設字母」 now matches the button label 「重置字母」
Scoring and the five summary values are unchanged

platformDeploy.note: The push redeployed the Hub and runner Workers because test scripts and the lockfile changed; their source did not change and no new capability is needed.

failingFirst: scripts/check-hart-chart-migration.test.mjs: defaults lacked characterSet; logic/hartChineseChart.ts did not exist; version was 2.0.3

scripts/check-hart-chart-tutorial.test.mjs: the tutorial still read ［列,欄］ / [row, column]; rendering failed without the Chinese module, so the placeholder order, word groups, settings choice and input-method tests failed too
tdd.browserFixture: scripts/hart-chart-browser.mjs reads coordinates as [column,row], checks the screen-reader labels, adds --chinese (real composition events through CDP Input.imeSetComposition / Input.insertText: a wrong character, then the right one) and measures the decoder on every run: no word split across lines, no word outside the decoder, no sideways scrolling, cells >= 27.5px, coordinate text >= 7px, word gap wider than the cell gap. With --hard it presses Reset Letters until a word has 9+ fields.
